requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Preserve the required order: answer the question → catch fruit → reveal basket.
requirements.changes: Question retrieval has a cancellable generation/session/topic/difficulty identity. Leaving or replacing loading, changing topic/difficulty and starting a new request cancel the previous request. Late successes/failures cannot change the new screen or write the wrong topic’s question history. Valid question metadata must match the requested topic/difficulty. Leaving loading returns to usable setup.
requirements.verification: Three lifecycle tests with deliberately late/noncooperative provider callbacks and actual bundled grounded questions were added. Not executed on Mac. Existing bad-fruit/no-pass termination, exactly-one pass consumption and uncapped star-pass accumulation already exist and were not rewritten.
requirements.remainingIssues: Run new lifecycle tests and complete actual game UI sequence on founder Mac. These source changes do not establish full gameplay acceptance.
